factors.label: Homicides per 100,000, county proxy for crime

grade_method.note: Each factor scores 0 to 100 on a straight line between its zero and full values (clamped). Area score is the weighted mean of the factors present; area_conf is the share of total weight present. Missing factors are skipped, never scored as zero. Grade A >= 70, B >= 55, C >= 40, else D. A gross yield under 5.5% holds the grade at C and under 4% at D (score clipped to that band). No grade below population 1,000, without a gross yield (no home price basis) or under coverage 0.6; an A needs coverage 0.8. Crime is the county homicide death rate (County Health Rankings, NCHS mortality files), a county-level proxy: ZIP-level crime is not published for free.
